title: bot.ability.vocal.speech.encoding.output
description: Speech audio encoded by vocal's SpeechEncoding: a reference to the encoded audio and the sound fields of environment.sound, so playout can broadcast it as one.

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the encoded audio; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Optional media type or codec label, such as audio/pcm or audio/opus.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Optional sample rate for raw or decoded audio, measured in hertz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Optional number of audio channels represented by the chunk.
channels.title: Channels

duration.description: Seconds of sound, measured from the encoded audio rather than estimated; null when the form does not say [floppy field].
duration.title: Duration
